04/23/2025
Claimant reported a rear-end impact while the insured vehicle was parked in a lot, and the claim was opened the

06/26/2025
The driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time of the reported loss. Nothing suggests the

Claimant is represented by counsel, who has asked that all contact go through their office. Future requests will be

06/30/2025
Responding officer's notes place the claimant in the vehicle at the scene. No witness account, photographs or

07/22/2025

known from prior claims or inspections.
07/30/2025

09/03/2025
Claimant's initial statement was recorded by phone. A follow-up interview added a few minor details about position
and speed, but the core account stayed the same.
09/25/2025
Medical records show a neck and back strain, which is a plausible injury for a collision of this type. Claimant was
referred for physical therapy.
09/30/2025
Prior records show treatment to the same body area within the last two years. That earlier condition appears to add to
the current complaints and will be considered in evaluating the injury.
11/23/2025
Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved. Latest therapy notes describe reduced
pain and better range of motion.
12/01/2025

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
